circulate.definition: To send a document to a group of people for information, usually with no action required.
circulate.example: I circulated the minutes to everyone on the project.

main_course.definition: The main dish of the meal, usually the largest and most expensive item.
main_course.example: What would you recommend for the main course?

sense.definition: One of the ways your body finds out about the world. You have five main ones.
sense.example: Smell is a sense that helps you find food.

wh_bonding.definition: Joining metal parts to each other so that they cannot sit at different voltages.
wh_bonding.example: Bonding of the metal pipework is part of the installation.
